partitionPolicy: All 30 annotated photos are assigned to validation as one conservative group. No photo or variant may enter training. Source separation is user-reported; exact/equivalent position overlap with the original photo development batch was checked. This is not a final evaluation set.
conversion: Full-size EXIF-normalized RGB sRGB PNG and quality-95 JPEG review copies. Original HEICs retained. No cropping, inference or sharpening.

overviewReview.scope: Initial quality and visible variety only; not a square-by-square label or corner review.
observations: Different piece silhouettes, flat and wood-textured boards, and several board colors are visible.
Both board orientations, tilted views, moire/color bands, highlights and arrows are represented.
The main digital boards appear complete at overview scale; precise borders still need individual review.
The photographs show a similar monitor and capture setting; variety of cameras and screens is not established.
Some consecutive photographs may belong to the same game or video. Do not infer independence from different positions or styles.

sourceSeparationConfirmation.statement: The user deliberately avoided the games and videos used in the previous batch. An accidental repeated position remains possible.
sourceSeparationConfirmation.groupingPolicy: Keep all 30 photographs in a single conservative validation batch. This is a partition safeguard, not a claim that they share one source or represent 30 independent sources. Never move a subset into training.

readinessNote: All annotations reviewed; validation square arrays and a training-consumable index have not been exported.

partitionReview.basis: User-confirmed distinct source selection, all samples held together, and no matching position families against the prior photo development manifest. Source separation is not independently proven.
